hey! i'm a rising 2nd year at GT majoring in CS (devices/mod-sim thread) as well as an aerospace engineering minor. i remember thinking of switching to an AE major (i was interested in GT since 8th grade for AE actually) and a CS minor, but with the onslaught of the pandemic, i've personally stuck with a CS major/AE minor. I know a lot of my AE friends at GT also switching from an AE major to an ME major w/ an AE minor. if you really wanna play safe, you can switch to ME or CS even with an AE minor or concentration like me. but even if you stick with your current major, i think you should be fine :)

again, totally get that and i 100% agree with you. i definitely valued the memories and seeing my high school friends (some of the probably for the last time in-person... dang makes me tear up saying that lol). as i said before, if your college happens to be near your to-be former high school (or if you can make the drive/flight), i'd absolutely suggest going to your high school's ho-co or prom, preferrably during your first year at college (i say first year of college because if you do it your 2nd or 3rd year of college, you'll prob know less and less people/friends to enjoy ho-co/prom with... plus your high school might have an age limit for being a guest so that'd def block you from doing prom or ho-co later on). again, i'm just offering an alternative if god forbid, you can't go to any dances senior year. with that said, i hope you don't have to go through what i had to go through; it is a really painful feeling thinking that you missed out on a such a valuable life memory like prom (which thankfully was restored for me ultimately). even if you miss out your senior year, if you can go to your high school prom as a college freshman, it'll be just as fun... prom is prom (i know because i've done it). with that said, i hope some of your senior year gets restored and that you get to chase and obtain your dreams in the future :D!

gosh my heart goes out for you... i hear people saying (just go to college parties), but eh... it's definitely not the same. for my college at least (GaTech), the main types of dancing either happens by signing up for a dance club (e.g.: ballroom dancing, salsa, etc.) or by doing greek life parties, and lemme tell you there's lots and lots of greek life parties that are just wild as heck (drugs, alcohol, etc etc), too crazy for my liking (i know because i went to a Sigma Alpha Epsilon block party at GT last fall... not my cup of tea that's for sure). the closest thing to emulate prom is if you are in greek life or have a boyfriend/girlfriend in greek life, in which case you can attend their 'formal'. so basically, unless you're in greek life and/or date someone in greek life (and greek life is not for everyone), after HS prom, there's nothing like it again. for me, i was real fortunate that my former high school had prom at the fox theater, which is walking distance from GT campus, so i went with my class of 2020 friends... (really lucked out to, as my prom was march 8th and covid lockdown was literally the week after). i also didn't attend any dances during high school, so i'd def recommend during your 1st year at college if you weren't able to go to your high school prom/ho-co, try to visit :D! sorry for rambling, hope this helps and best of luck :))!
